profile.name: 封膜机后端控制组件
profile.description: 这是一个非实体的软件控制组件，用于定义实验室封膜机的基础控制接口，包括封膜、温度设置与温度读取，供上层实验流程或具体硬件实现调用。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component that defines the basic control interface for a laboratory sealer, including sealing, temperature setting, and temperature readback, for use by higher-level workflows or concrete hardware implementations.

registry.name: Plate Sealer (Backend)
registry.description: Plate Sealer (Backend) 后端模块是一款封膜仪，主要功能包括关闭、打开、温度设置、温度读取。支持Signal, Slot, seal等操作。
